rationale: Russian mass-casualty strike on buses in Kramatorsk killed at least 30 civilians in a deliberate attack, representing a significant escalation in targeting of civilians on Ukrainian territory. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
top_events.label: Russia strikes buses in Kramatorsk killing 30
top_events.summary: Russia deliberately targeted two crowded buses in Kramatorsk, killing at least 30 civilians in a mass-casualty attack. This represents a significant escalation in civilian targeting.

top_events.title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
top_events.label: Winter strikes force Kyiv residents to flee
top_events.summary: Renewed Russian strikes on energy infrastructure are forcing some Kyiv residents to leave the capital as winter approaches, continuing the pressure on civilian life.

top_events.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
top_events.label: Pentagon to livestream firing squad execution
top_events.summary: The Pentagon announces it will livestream a firing squad execution, an unprecedented decision. No direct impact on Ukraine.

most_significant_event.label: Russia launches 130 drones 48 missiles overnight
most_significant_event.summary: Massive overnight barrage of 130 drones, 48 cruise and ballistic missiles kills at least 24. Continuation of large-scale infrastructure attacks.
most_significant_event.title: At least 24 killed as Russia launches massive attack on Ukraine
